pages.text: Press Start. The reactor runs every step itself and holds with a reason if something is short.$(br2)A cold start takes about $(bold)2 minutes$(); the very first adds a 1-minute commissioning.

pages.title: Steps
pages.text: $(li)Power check, 10 s$(li)Reserve bank charge, 20 s$(li)Stabilizer spin-up, 30 s$(li)Antimatter injection, 20 s$(li)Matter priming, 15 s$(li)Ignition, 5 s$(li)Ramp, 20 s

pages.title: Startup Power
pages.text: The reserve charge and spin-up draw about $(bold)1 MW$() from the grid. Have an SFR-1 "Solstice" and full batteries ready before you press Start.
